notes: FX per RULES.md: USD 1 = EUR 0.880, GBP 1 = EUR 1.165. Every value = original figure converted at these rates; no freight added unless stated.

Method limit: every page fetch (plasticker.de, kiweb.de, kunststoffweb.de, clickplastics.com, businessanalytiq.com, polymerupdate.com) failed on DNS from this sandbox; all figures were read from search-engine extracts of the cited pages. 27 web searches used.

No German-specific (Kunststoff Information) price LEVEL could be read: KI's monthly EUR/t levels are subscriber-only; only KI headlines were visible (Sep 2026: PP slightly down on oversupply; PE order stops and October surcharges sought; engineering thermoplastics softened broadly, +50-80 EUR/t sought for October). Commodity values use myCEPPI (Central/Eastern Europe market price, week 37/2026) as the nearest direct-buy level; Plastech (offer) and businessanalytiq (Europe) are given as cross-checks and run 20-50% higher for PE/PP — the true German delivered level for an automotive tier is probably between myCEPPI and businessanalytiq.

Context: European polymers spiked in Q2 2026 (myCEPPI week 18/2026: PP homo IM 2,089, HDPE IM 2,100, LDPE 2,360, ABS 2,988 EUR/t; propylene April contract 1,465 EUR/t FD NWE) and have fallen back sharply since; prices are moving, so date matters.
Engineering resins (PC, PA6, PA66, PBT, PET, PMMA, EPDM, NBR) use businessanalytiq Europe indices (aggregator, method not published) — moderate confidence; POM uses Plastech (offer level).

Current-book figures that look wrong (current v evidence, EUR/kg): mat-pmma 2.88 is low v 3.25 (businessanalytiq Sep); mat-pom 2.46 is low v 2.70 (Plastech Sep); mat-upvc 1.35 is ~36% above S-PVC resin 0.99 (myCEPPI W37) if it is resin; mat-gpps 1.66 v 1.53 slightly high and mat-hips 1.66 = GPPS but HIPS trades ~0.14 above GPPS (1.68); mat-pet-bg 1.47 v 1.37 slightly high; mat-peek 89.25 is above Victrex's all-mix ASP 79.22 (an upper bound for industrial granule) — likely high; mat-cf-dry-3k 30.24 (3K woven fabric) is about equal to generic carbon fibre 29.92 (IMARC Germany Mar 2026) — a woven 3K fabric costs more than fibre, so it looks low.
Rubber book grades are 'xx Shore A' compounds and not directly comparable with the raw-polymer prices here (book EPDM 70A 2.23 v EPDM polymer 2.83; book NBR 70A 2.72 v NBR polymer 1.93).

Not found: any market price for PA66-GF30, PA6-GF30, PP-GF30, PP-TD20, TPE (KI / PIE compound lists paywalled); European glass fibre; T700 12K specifically; a September businessanalytiq PA6 / NBR / LLDPE / POM figure.
